svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: macOS · Editor preview page in its own window · interval, originals on PicPlace · 1000×700
svg.desc: Mirrors App/EditorPreviewPage.swift `railBody(in:)` in a Mac window of its own — `PreviewEditorWindowRequest`, the `WindowGroup(for:)` in App/LetsLapseApp.swift (default 1000 × 700, min 720 × 480, titled `navigationTitle(request.title)`) — plan §10 (stage 2) and §16; new 2026-09-26. On the Mac a preview's Edit opens the preview page in its own window where a project with its originals opens `PhotoEditorWindowRequest`: the project screen's hero Edit pill (App/ProjectDetailView.swift `openPreviewPage`), and `EditorOpenRequest.open(with:)` (App/EditorLaunch.swift) opens the same window for any `.preview` request made where no item view hosts the editor (the Gallery panel's Edit without an `onEdit` host); the Gallery's item view hosts the same page in place instead (plan §8's macOS/gallery.item.preview.svg). It is its own view (`EditorPreviewPageContent`, T6), built from the editor's components with a `locked` state — never the editor mounted on a poster, so it has no write path (no persist net, no white migration, no as-shot reads); when the originals land the window's page becomes `PhotoViewerView` in place, on the page and panel asked for. The window's chrome owns the title and the close — no Back, no ⓘ (`touchChrome` / `railChrome` are iOS only), no clear preview. LAYOUT: the page on LL.screenBackground; the picture pane (`picturePane(anchor: .center)`, black, 669 × 672) with poster.jpg fitted and centred — a 3:4 shoot is 504 × 672 at x 102.5; a hairline Divider; the fixed 330 pt rail (`railWidth`, macOS) — a ScrollView padded 14 top / 16 sides / 20 bottom, 12 between: App/RailTabBar.swift (`locked`) — the white capsule, Editor in LL.accent with a white label, Text · Frames · Masks accent at 38 %, still clickable (they ask); App/EditorControls/EditorGroupBar.swift (`.macCard`, `locked: true`) — the white card, six 46 pt cells #6D6D72 at 42 %, none selected, the dots LL.accent at 55 % (Presets, Light); then `statusCard(style: .light)` (`railCardStyle`, macOS): LL.cardBackground, radius 16, padding 12, NO badge (the marquee badge is the dark style's), the glyph in the light palette — `StatusGlyphView(.asset(.originals, .there), size 13, surface .adaptive)`: the grey camera #AEAEB2 (§16) — 'Preview only' 13 pt semibold primary; the caption 11.5 pt #6D6D72 — 'Editing needs \(noun.text) — on PicPlace · \(shortfall.sizeText)' wrapping in the 155.4 pt column to three lines ('Editing needs the originals' / '— on PicPlace · 55 files ·' / '209,9 MB'); 'Download' 13 pt semibold LL.accent trailing on the title's line — 298 × 83.7 at y 184. A click on a greyed control or on the card asks: the same `.alert` and words as the phone (iOS/project-photo.viewer.preview.prompt.portrait.svg — 'Download the originals?', 'Light needs the originals — 55 files · 209,9 MB on PicPlace. …', Download and Continue · Stay as Is), drawn by AppKit; while the download runs the card reads as the phone's progress (…preview.downloading) with LL.accent for the bar and Stop. Window geometry is macOS/photo-viewer.svg's (28 pt title bar, centred title, the 669 pt pane); the stage-2 screenshot of this window (2026-09-25, a photo's preview, before §16's camera) seats the tab capsule, the buttons card and the status card at the same 14 / 12 / 12 pt steps under macOS 26's taller (32 pt) title bar, whose title sits leading. Title: an interval project's dated `displayTitle` ('Stack <day. month.> at <time>'). HOOK: `LL_DROP_SOURCES=<uuid>` on a Mac scratch root (`-storage.libraryRootPath`) in one launch; in the next, the project screen's Edit pill opens this window (press it by AX).

mirrors App/EditorPreviewPage.swift railBody + statusCard(.light) — locked RailTabBar / EditorGroupBar(.macCard) · plan §10
